Each change carries observation: live (our sync saw it when it happened) or catch

tools.name: launch_on_time_record
tools.description: How often launches fly on time: the share of flown launches that lifted off within 1 day and within 7 days of the first firm date on record, with mean and median delay, grouped by provider, vehicle or launch site.

tools.name: recent_funding_rounds
tools.description: Closed private funding rounds into space companies in the last 90 days, newest first, with amount (null when undisclosed, never estimated), stage, investors, how the round is evidenced and its source link.

tools.name: company_lookup
tools.description: Public profile facts for a space company: what it does, sector, country, headquarters, founding year, public or private, ticker, total funding and last round as shown on its profile, and its Space Score when it is ranked.

tools.name: space_weather_now
tools.description: Current geomagnetic Kp and NOAA G-scale, solar wind speed, density and Bz, the NOAA 3-day flare outlook and flares in the last 14 days, with a plain-language read for satellite operators. NOAA SWPC and NASA DONKI data.

tools.name: moon_race_status
tools.description: The US vs China Moon race tracker: milestones demonstrated on both 8-rung ladders (crewed landing and sustained presence), who leads each, the projection call with its date bands, official targets and the next uncrewed landing attempt.

tools.name: space_jobs_count
tools.description: How many open roles the SpaceNexus jobs board lists right now (mirrored daily from employers' careers pages), how many employers are hiring, how many roles are new this week or remote, and optionally one employer's open roles.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search spacenexus.us: companies, rockets, launches, launch sites, guides, charts, Moon missions, funding rounds and analysis. Returns titles, one-line descriptions and the canonical URL of each page.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site · Private data: launch_on_time_record, recent_funding_rounds, company_lookup, launch_ledger_record, promise_ledger_entries, dataset_links, funding_round_history, space_score_history · Public sink: launch_on_time_record, funding_round_history.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site · Private data: launch_on_time_record, recent_funding_rounds, company_lookup, launch_ledger_record, promise_ledger_entries, dataset_links, funding_round_history, space_score_history · Public sink: launch_on_time_record, funding_round_history

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
